title: Quickstart scaffold: adaptive tiles & staged screenshot system
creator: Asha Patel
description: Replace the existing static hero and step list with an adaptive tile scaffold that stages contextual product screenshots based on user intent. The goal is to reduce first-time confusion, shorten time-to-first-success, and provide clearer paths for engineers to try hosted vs. dedicated vs. private workflows. This ticket covers the visual system, annotated screenshots (desktop / mobile / small widths), and the handoff files for engineering and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Adaptive tile scaffold implemented in Figma with responsive constraints for 320–1440px widths
Three staged screenshot templates (Quick API call, Dedicated pool config, VPC/private deployment) with real UI chrome and callouts
Accessible color contrast and updated microcopy approved by Content and PM
Exportable assets: SVG hero illustration, 1x/2x PNG screenshot sets, and a lightweight CSS spec for engineering
Handoff package uploaded to Drive + PRD links in Confluence and a signed-off review by PM
Visual QA checklist completed across Chrome and Safari, desktop and mobile breakpoints
design_decisions: We opted for a modular tile approach instead of a single wide hero to improve scannability at small widths. Trade-offs: more assets to maintain vs. better progressive disclosure of product modes. Chose lighter vector treatments to reduce cognitive load and kept screenshots mostly unblurred because real UI affordances help convert engineers faster. Deferred an animated hero to a follow-up sprint to reduce engineering footprint for this release.
